# Travel MVP Quality Checklist: Personalized Travel Agent MVP

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review for the Da Nang travel-agent MVP (Vietnamese NL, feasibility-first planning, mobile client)
**Created**: 2026-09-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Vietnamese Language Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Clarification behavior is defined for missing city vs missing time (ask vs assume)?
- [ ] CHK002 "Yên tĩnh", "hợp hẹn hò" style preferences have a defined mapping to verifiable POI attributes (not free-floating adjectives)?
- [ ] CHK003 Onboarding 5 questions cover budget, pace, food, fitness, must-avoid with no gaps?
- [ ] CHK004 Explanation language requirement (Vietnamese-only) is stated and uncertainty wording is specified?

## POI Data Requirements

- [ ] CHK005 Every POI field in snapshot schema has a defined source and freshness rule?
- [ ] CHK006 Criteria for "verified" vs "uncertainty-labeled" POI are unambiguous?
- [ ] CHK007 Must-visit override rules vs novelty penalty are stated without contradiction?
- [ ] CHK008 Restaurant-specific fields (cuisine, crowd, dietary, reservation) have defined sources?

## Optimizer & Feasibility Requirements

- [ ] CHK009 Hard vs soft constraint lists are exhaustive for 1–2 day Da Nang trips?
- [ ] CHK010 Preference-order (hiking-before-beach) has a defined representation as constraint, not prose?
- [ ] CHK011 Infeasible-itinerary response (reasons + relax suggestions) format is specified?
- [ ] CHK012 Multi-plan diversity (savings/balanced/experience) definitions don't overlap ambiguously?

## Evaluator Honesty Requirements

- [ ] CHK013 Gate-before-scoring order is explicit (no quality scores on gate failure)?
- [ ] CHK014 Fact vs inference labeling rules for explanations are testable?
- [ ] CHK015 Pairwise comparison procedure (what is compared, how winner is decided) is defined?

## Dynamic & Money Requirements

- [ ] CHK016 Completed-activity preservation rule has no exceptions left undefined?
- [ ] CHK017 Plan-vs-clarify-vs-no-solution decision criteria are stated?
- [ ] CHK018 Budget alert thresholds (80%/100%) and remaining-budget feedback into replan are specified?
- [ ] CHK019 Weather-cache staleness labeling (fetched_at display) is required?

## Scope Boundaries

- [ ] CHK020 Out-of-scope list (booking, OCR, voice, multi-city, RL) has no overlap with P1 stories?

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
